releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.207: Adds two selectable Home Screen Widget shortcuts: Smart Search opens the existing notes search field, and Quick Note opens the existing blank note editor ready to type. All twelve shortcut routes, prior settings, 3D button feedback, text-size choices, responsive padding, and resize behavior are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web bundle update. Existing saved data and app identity are preserved.
